reviews.author: Michael C.
reviews.text:
This is by far the most beautiful campsite I've been to in Oregon.   TONS of green space between the sites (we could just barely see one neighboring campsite), and our site was right on a beautiful stretch of river.

Easy back-in for the trailer too--which is saying something, with our 34' trailer!

This was our second time at this campground.  The campsite we got last time was equally amazing.

reviews.author: Babbette M.
reviews.text: Quiet. Beautiful. Great fishing. What more could anyone ask for. It will be one of favorite destinations.

reviews.author: Gary E.
reviews.text: The site was not very clean. Although posted as such, no recycle bin near the restroom. Campground was mostly empty the days leading up to Independence Day weekend with only about six sites occupied. Some camp site signage is looking fairly sad and in need of replacement. Our site table was very unlevel and showing its age with rotten wood exposed. The tables are very heavy, so could not make level for us senior citizens.

reviews.author: Ashley L.
reviews.text: We absolutely loved this campground! While we completely missed the note about how close these spaces are (the ones we were in are seriously sharing picnic areas), it didn't matter as we had 4 sites in a row with family. Being close to the river was amazing; it drowned out any road noise or noise from other campers (not including generators). Highly recommend this spot for being near Crater Lake!

reviews.author: Nathalie Y.
reviews.text: Pretty cool spot! Lots of bear so be aware

reviews.author: Andrew T.
reviews.text: This campground has been a family tradition for over 20 years. There has only been one time i have been disappointed and that was when after the thining of the brush and timber was done and the water lines we broke and the water pump failed. This is a amazing campground with tons of fishing and swimming opportunities along with a quiet atmosphere. I would recommend this campground for any family looking to enjoy a amazing experience and a amazing atmosphere.

reviews.author: Debra P.
reviews.text: Beautiful campground

reviews.author: Piaw K.
reviews.text:
Great campsite with all amenities(clean toilet+ fresh drinking which are huge for me). The host was super friendly and the campsite we stayed in was beautiful that tucked away from other sites and has a river beach access(bonus for the dogs). This campground is right next to a hiking trail and is easy to stroll you can stroll and enjoy the river/forest view. 

We will def be back again!

reviews.author: calvin B.
reviews.text: nice campground

reviews.author: James b.
reviews.text: The camp ground was really well kept. Clean, flushable bathrooms. Playground for kids. Super friendly host who even allows you to connect to his StarLink (Wifi) for free since there’s no connection out there. He even sold me firewood for 5 bucks. There’s a beautiful creek about 50 yards from the campground that you can swim in. Really amazing experience and one of my favorite campground thus far! There’s a bunch of sites but they’re pretty spread out so you get some privacy. Me and my girlfriend felt very comfortable and safe. Will definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Janet R.
reviews.text: Campground was a beautiful location. Our camp site backed up to a river. However, we were there four days and the men’s bathrooms were filthy and disgusting. The host didn’t clean the men’s toilets the entire four days. The exact same mess was on the men’s toilets for Tuesday thru Saturday. They were unusable! We have camped at many, many Forest service campgrounds that have been wonderful; this was by far the dirtiest men’s bathroom.

reviews.author: Kim S.
reviews.text:
The campground HOST, Kevin(?) was so kind and helpful, and checked up on everyone and their needs, Thank you! 
 Nice that the trail along the river was so accessible, great for an evening walk to view the gorge.  
Improvements: The bathrooms need an alternative to the broken hand sanitizer containers! He said they expected him to buy soap with his own money?? Silly. That is a basic ammenity to have available and functioning. 
There is road noise, bring earplugs! The campsites further from the road obviously are better for more quiet.

reviews.author: Steve D.
reviews.text:
This campsite was absolutely wonderful. If you can snag a site on the water, you will be very happy.
What makes this campground exceptional is the host, a man named Kevin. He is actually taking the job of “Campground Host” seriously. By that I mean that he is almost always “on duty” and available to help in anyway needed. We felt so welcomed and taken care of by Kevin during our stay. He even brought our firewood to us at our campsite and helped us to fill up our fresh water tank with water when we arrived. We’ve been to a lot of National Forest campgrounds and this camp host really stood out!
Wonderful waterfalls in this area and great hiking. So relaxing. Our neighbors were catching trout right out of the river behind our camp spots.

reviews.author: Margaret F.
reviews.text: Got our favorite spot and had a lovely time.  It’s nice to be back after two years of not being able to camp there.  So many trees were removed.  Sad but necessary.

reviews.author: Robert F.
reviews.text:
The spaces where very nice the river is great but the maintenance and cleanliness of restrooms leaves much to be desired.
There was no soap in either restroom they were not cleaned daily and the sinks did not drain properly.
The host stated that he was not supplied with soaps for restrooms 
The motion lights at restrooms did not work properly and the recycle stations where not set up 
The area had danger trees removed last year but the slash was not cleaned up very well

reviews.author: valerie l.
reviews.text: I love at farewell bend. And camp Host is Good man.The fishing is Grat.and it is so peaceful.

reviews.author: Cindy L.
reviews.text: The location is beautiful and sites near the river are generally away from the highway noise.  Unfortunately, it's clear there is no money for maintenance and the bathrooms were showing a lot of disrepair.  The site provides great access to hiking opportunities and to Crater Lake.

reviews.author: Michael F.
reviews.text: Outstanding

reviews.author: Ruth N.
reviews.text: Our campsite (#24) was spacious and mostly private. We had a view of the Rogue River and enjoyed hearing the sound of the rushing water below us. It was a short walk to the heated campground bathroom - which was well lit, clean and well supplied with soap, paper towels and toilet paper.   Kevin, our Campground Host and his dog Buddy were very friendly and helpful. During your stay be sure to stop in at Beckie's Restaurant for their delicious pies.  Also, don't miss the Natural Bridge Trail (easy walk) -  where the Upper Rogue River plunges underground through an ancient 250-foot basalt lava tube. This campground place was a perfect place to stay while visiting Crater Lake National Park and the surrounding areas.

reviews.author: John R.
reviews.text: Convenient basecamp for Crater Lake.  We enjoyed our campsite next to the Rogue River, which drowned out the sounds of vehicles on the nearby highway.  The tent sites are much more cozy than the 40 foot RV sites.  Be aware that there is no Wi-Fi or cell phone coverage.

reviews.author: Howard S.
reviews.text: Always a great stay even if weather did not cooperate. Swainson's Thrushes were back for beautiful musical background.

reviews.author: Madison L.
reviews.text: I loved it here! Nice and secluded, beautiful view/creek access from our spot, and the Union Creek stop right down the road was lovely!

reviews.author: Manasi S.
reviews.text: Great warden. Beautiful spot.

reviews.author: Francine G.
reviews.text: Beautiful location, campsite right on the river, helpful host.

reviews.author: Suzette W.
reviews.text: A great campground anytime of the year! Spaces 1-12 are quite barren now due to the removal of some trees and underbrush.

reviews.author: Susan D.
reviews.text: This is a beautiful campground right on the river! Unparallel beauty and tranquility (although we were there in early October so not too many neighbors).  The bathrooms had running water and there are water spickets along the campground.  We enjoyed our stay and recommend this location!

reviews.author: joe m.
reviews.text: Always a great time at Farewell Bend.  It's beautiful

reviews.author: Christina  D.
reviews.text: We loved staying right by the river!  Campground and ba to rooms were well maintained!

reviews.author: Michael M.
reviews.text:
This was a beautiful campsite along the river. I would highly suggest booking a campsite along the river if available as the rushing water definitely helped drown out any neighborly noise and was pleasant to fall asleep to. 

The campground is very close to Crater Lake (25mins to the west gate) where you can find a restaurant and gas. There is also a small restaurant and store about 5 minutes south of the campground that has most basic supplies (for anything you might forget). 

In addition to Crater Lake, be sure to check out Rogue River Gorge Viewpoint about a 5minute drive south of the campground.

reviews.author: Bruce O.
reviews.text:
Great Location 
Lots of Shade and Privacy

reviews.author: Maryann M.
reviews.text: The campground was nice with large private sites, and  the bathrooms had both flush toilets and electricity.  The soap ran out in the women’s restroom and wasn’t replaced for several days.  The Rogue Gorge and Takelma Gorge were both amazing.  The Upper Rogue trail is well kept and gives a lot of hiking options.  The campground is only 25 miles from Crater Lake for an easy day trip.

reviews.author: Richard  J.
reviews.text: Nice shady spot near the River.

reviews.author: Catherine C.
reviews.text: I stayed in site 1, and while it is close to the hwy, it was not very noisy at all.  The sites are well spaced, so you do not feel like you are camping right on top of the next site.  Site 1 is also right along the river, so you have the sound of the water as well. The campground was in the process of some maintenance work, so fallen trees and branches were gathered into piles that would be removed in the future.  I would definitely stay here again if I were to pass through the area.

reviews.author: Joel M.
reviews.text: I don't want to write a review but this is forcing me to.

reviews.author: Paul H.
reviews.text:
Great spot… Right next to the river! It was delightful to fall asleep to the sound of rushing waters. The camp host was very helpful, as we were in the area to do the Crater  Lake  “ride the rim event” . ( the east rim drive portion of the road is closed to vehicular traffic  & bicyclists and pedestrians have an unobstructed view from all the pull outs.)
    We were unclear as to our timeline and whether we could get back to camp in time AND THE CAMP HOST,had some great advice. This campground is a hidden gem!

reviews.author: Samyucktha K.
reviews.text: We booked this site for 2 nights for 12 adults, 4 dogs and a kid and ended up being 8 adults and 4 dogs. Though the site occupancy is for 16pax, it would have been really tight for that many people. Great location, plenty of open space right next to the site, the dogs enjoyed. It was pretty secluded on both sides with trees, we could not see/hear our neighbors. Water was available 2 sites away and the toilets were located pretty close to the site as well. The women washrooms were super clean at all times, men washrooms had bugs in them and there was no soap in either of the toilets throughout. Overall, a great experience and definitely wouldn't mind visiting again.

reviews.author: Mark H.
reviews.text: good river access, clean campground & bathrooms

reviews.author: Marcia V.
reviews.text: Very nice site on the river. Scenic, quiet, super clean bathroom. Very helpful camp host. Caught two native trouts!

reviews.author: Jacob T.
reviews.text: Great stay!

reviews.author: Aly R.
reviews.text: It was such a great campground it was so peaceful with the river, I would totally recommend!

reviews.author: Marianne T.
reviews.text:
This was our base for exploring crater lake for a couple days. The campground is primitive and it appears that they are clearing out some dead trees with piles of brush stacked around. It’s close to the road so some truck noise but quiet throughout most of the night. Sites are long, fairly level and accommodate the trailer and truck no problem.
We enjoyed the quiet and the dark sky - LOTs of stars!

reviews.author: JEFFREY A.
reviews.text:
The campsites and restrooms were very well maintained.   Also, the camp host Kevin was very friendly, helpful. and did a great job.
It's a short drive to Crater Lake National Park from the campground, but even spending the day fishing and hiking along the Rogue River, which runs through Farewell Bend, is a nice way to spend a day.

reviews.author: Tracy S.
reviews.text:
It is a dark campground due to the canyon and trees. You will get about 5 hours of shaded sun.  

If that doesnt bother you it is a good site.  But I like a little bit more sun.

reviews.author: Wes C.
reviews.text: Beautiful campground. Huge picnic table, plenty of room for multiple tents if needed, right across from the bathroom and right next to the river. The only downside would be how some people are going though your campsite in order to get to the river but most of them apologized for passing though and it really wasn’t that big of a deal. Otherwise it’s a huge campground with plenty of space in between neighbors so it doesn’t feel like you’re camping right next to someone

reviews.author: Mengge M.
reviews.text:
We absolutely loved camping here! Campsite #18 is right on Rouge River. We fell asleep to the roaring sound of the river, which perfectly blocked any noise we would’ve heard from the highway or our neighbors. The location is oddly convenient. There is a country store minutes away, and plenty of attractions to check out in the surrounding area. 
The camp host is friendly and professional. We’d love to return to this campground in the future. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Maria M.
reviews.text: The quiet campground with large individual sites was within easy distance to Crater Lake. Facilities (flush toilets, running water) were reasonably clean and functional. The road for people, like myself, not accustomed to night driving through forest was not scary - just be careful of deer. We enjoyed a nice stroll to the Rogue River gorge pretty much in the campground. The sound of the river eclipsed the mild-moderate road noise, minimal after dark.

reviews.author: jan lee m.
reviews.text: Lovely.

reviews.author: Bibek A.
reviews.text: Loved the campsite. It was peaceful with the river flowing sounds and birds chirping. All worth it

reviews.author: Kyle S.
reviews.text: The camp host Kevin is ON POINT! We brought a brand new Blackstone camp griddle and the dang thing was a dud from the manufacturer !!! In comes Kevin: U can borrow my little grill! He brought it to our camp site and we grilled all weekend!!! You Rock Kevin!!

reviews.author: Amy A.
reviews.text: Beautiful campground. Clean and well maintained. Our site was very private and quiet. The main road is pretty close but the sound of the river nearby covers any sound from the road. There was plenty of room for a big tent or multiple tents. Would stay here again.

reviews.author: Veronica P.
reviews.text: solid campsite! easy to get in and out. a bit of a walk to bathrooms but nothing unmanageable. Good place to stay!

reviews.author: Kelly K.
reviews.text: Stayed here while we visited Crater Lake in July.  Not many people.  Next to River.  Could hear some traffic noise.  No camp host and burn piles everywhere. The drive to Crater was not too bad.  Mosquitos were brutal.

reviews.author: Kelly B.
reviews.text: This campground has so much... potential.   Admittedly we went during a time it had posted that they'd thinned trees and had the trimmings visible.   Fortunately, we had a site right on the creek (river?) otherwise it would have been depressing! There were others camped with these giant heaping mounds of trimmed trees and pine needles etc. Our site was lovely, but the campground otherwise felt desolate and sad!   There was caution tape across the host site, with a "want to be a host? call here" sign.   Which was puzzling. Until I learned that the lowest # campsites currently have no water.  Guess a line got cut.  The flush toilets... well the one near us wouldn't flush. Probably that line!  That was the nicer one.   We had to walk quite a ways to the next one (5-7 min walk!).  At least those flushed, but the faucet literally turned in the sink.  As pretty as my site was, I'm saying farewell to farewell bend....

reviews.author: Dennis G.
reviews.text: We so much enjoyed being right next to the Rogue River. The setting is wonderfully beautiful. We were concerned about the removal of so much vegetation next to the highway. This causes more road noise as there in now no buffer. It would be nice if a shower were in the facility. Flush toilets were nice to have. We plan to return ~ and, hopefully have the same spot.

reviews.author: Jill K.
reviews.text: It was a beautiful location. The only downside was that there was a water issue and we couldn’t use the toilets for one full day

reviews.author: TERRY N.
reviews.text: We love Farewell Bend. It is a beautiful spot for dry camping.

reviews.author: Joanne  A.
reviews.text:
Wonderful secluded and peaceful spot despite the number of pitches at the site. Our camping spot was close by to the river which made it feel quite exclusive and we were able to stroll down to the river whenever we liked, which was great. 
Good location for day trips to Crater Lake. Our only issue was we didn’t have enough time here. Would like to visit again.

reviews.author: Terry B.
reviews.text: Nice park and convenient to Crater Lake!   A little too much rain, but its September (frown).

reviews.author: Jessica C.
reviews.text: Beautiful spot! Great for families. Close to Crater Lake.

reviews.author: Quentin S.
reviews.text: It would be nice to reserve spots next to each other without having to reserve the double sides

reviews.author: Laura B.
reviews.text:
great camping experience, water for sites well located. Note there are many spots that can't be reserved, nice ones by the river.  
Be sure and explore the gorge trail, well marked, but not well publicized.  
Get trail maps for entire Crater Lake area before you leave, not readily available once you get there

reviews.author: Michael S.
reviews.text: The campground was clean, and the site was spacious. Easy to back into with my 33ft 5th wheel.  Good access to Crater Lake.

reviews.author: Louis  M.
reviews.text: The campsite was great and we are looking forward to going back next year.The only thing that would of been better is if there was a dump station for our trailers that is closer then Shady Cove.

reviews.author: Debra K.
reviews.text: We camped here in a 40 ft 5th Wheel. It was a tight drive through the campground but if your careful, shouldn't have a problem. The campsites were spacious & felt secluded. Bathrooms were fairly clean. It is a wonderful campground, especially for dark sky viewing. Loved the river flowing behind most the sites. It was quiet & relaxing. I would definitely use this campground again!

reviews.author: Toby D.
reviews.text:
I dont usually fill out a review. I've camped here for the last five or six years. The issue I have is with the camphost. The last couple years the camphost has been sub-performing Both trips this year, they aren't present.  They hang up a sign, especially for my second trip, stating "camp host off duty". Friday your off duty?  I was there for 3 days this time, and saw the camphost once.  That says alot seems how i was camping directly adjacent to their site. I watched alot of folks come in then leave. I assume this was because it was unclear on how to get a campsite.  The bathrooms are being cleaned by what appears to be contracted help. Last year there wasnt any TP in the bathrooms. There are notes hanging in the bathroom for 3 weeks that the soap dispensers are empty. The camphost is not selling firewood, but they have built a wall around their camp out of rounds. Probably a few cords worth. 
All of these issues don't actually impact me cause I come prepared, but I have never seen anything like this anywhere I've camped. I had to change my own reservation paperwork on the site markers. This is one of my favorite campgrounds and I feel like there should be a camphost there that, A) Is there  and B) is doing their job.
In my opinion,  I think the current camphost is a "squatter ".  I'm basing this on behavior and the fact their site looks like a homeless camp.

reviews.author: Lauren K.
reviews.text:
The camp host, Mel, is amazing. She does everything she can to keep this place pristine and awesome. 

Some facility updates would be nice as the toilets require multiple flushes and several of the men’s toilets were completely clogged but that is not on Mel. 

It would be great if other campers would read her notes! People kept leaving trash by the recycling rather than walking it to the trash. If you go to a place as amazing as farewell bend, leave it better than you found it! 

We booked site 26 but when we got there, Mel moved us to 28, which was a much larger site. We were right on the river. 

This is a campground I will gladly return to!

reviews.author: Julie B.
reviews.text: Large sites. Rogue Gorge and Natural Bridge are very close, enjoyable, and had nice paved paths.

reviews.author: Allison B.
reviews.text: Farewell Bend is such a beautiful campground with tall trees, plenty of trails for walking, and campsites on the river! We loved sites 7, 8, 9, and 10 for our family trip.

reviews.author: Angela G.
reviews.text: This campground is the nicest place I have ever stayed. It is right on a creek with little waterfalls and swimming holes. Everything was so clean and the sites were big. Such a happy place

reviews.author: Clarke M.
reviews.text: Our campsite was dirty when we arrived, there was trash at the site and in the fire ring. Several trees had been cut down so there is not as much shade as there was in the past. And access to the river is now limited. I won’t be coming back.

reviews.author: Jody T.
reviews.text: Great location, great upkeep, love the playground!

reviews.author: Christine G.
reviews.text: This campground was great, but the camp host of June 2023 was NOT!  We had reserved and prepaid for 2 nights through recreation.gov.  We returned from Crater Lake NP about 5pm the second night and found another couple in our site.  The couple told us that the camp host had said the site was empty.  When we talked with the camp host, she said that nothing was left in the site, so she assumed we had left early.  My husband pointed out that we were in a self-contained camper van so there was nothing we could easily leave, but we had left a towel to dry on the picnic table.  She claimed nothing was left in the site and instead of apologizing she stated, “I’m the camp host and I can do what I want!”.  I asked what we were supposed to do now.  She said, “I can’t help you.”  (We drove about an hour and found a Snow Park to park the van for the night.)

reviews.author: Jennifer M.
reviews.text: This was a beautiful spot. I think we had one of the best spots in the campground. The river was right outside our tent, with several easy steps to access it. It's also a spot where they stock the fish. I've never camped at a site where bears weren't really present, that was new! Though the site I reserved automatically joined two sites, it was absolutely worth it. The folks around the camp ground were also very nice folks. I would love to come back again.

reviews.author: Kurt S.
reviews.text: Great location, drove in without a problem.

reviews.author: Pat D.
reviews.text:
Nice, quiet campground. Location by the river is great. 

Restroom & water faucet closest to my site needed work but the next set down were in great shape.

reviews.author: William S.
reviews.text:
Farewell Bend Campground is our favorite by far!! My wife and I can't get enough of it, which is why we spent 7 nights there this summer and hope to get a few more in this fall before it closes. The Rogue River is the biggest reason we love it. We always choose a site on the river, loving the sound and beauty it gives off. But the campground itself is wonderful. The bathrooms are alway clean; the campground is quiet, and the other campers are always fun to meet.

Keep up the good work. Thank you for maintaining this breathtakingly beautiful campground.

Bill Stenberg

reviews.author: Alec S.
reviews.text: Friendly camp host, clean bathrooms, fantastic stretch of creek to play in.

reviews.author: Todd H.
reviews.text: Annual trip. Always love it. Would like water restored to faucet across from campsite 40.

reviews.author: Aidan L.
reviews.text: Gorgeous. Right next to river and available swimming hole.

reviews.author: John L.
reviews.text: The campsites are great, whether on the river or the larger ones over closer to the roads.  Nice hikes down the Rogue River.

reviews.author: trish c.
reviews.text: Love farewell bend campground. The site was clean and bathrooms were ok. We were disappointed that we never once saw the camp hosts. They never checked in with us .

reviews.author: David T.
reviews.text:
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Farewell Bend. We were there Monday-Friday in our 27 foot motorhome. We had both site 35 & 36. Originally we planned to have friends occupy one site and wed have the other as they are less than 10 feet apart. Our friends backed out, but we kept both sites as they are so close together. I wouldn't recommend staying in only one site due to their close proximity. Overall, the sites are very spacious and reasonably level. Many, like ours, are right on the river. There's a lot of shade, but there was enough sun for my solar panels to fully charge my batteries by 4PM. The water spigot was only 20 steps away. There were several spots between campsites where you can be on the river without being on someone else's campsite. Road noise was minimal, mostly drowned out by the sound of the river rushing by. The bathrooms were clean, and the campground was well maintained. We hiked less than half a mile to Rogue Gorge, which is a fantastic site. I hiked about four miles to Natural Bridge. (Just take the Union Creek trail to the Rogue River trail.) That was even more fantastic! It was a great hike eight miles round trip. I even ran into a black bear about half a mile from the Union Creek campground, but it ran off as soon as I yelled "Hey bear!".
Overall we loved our stay at Farewell Bend. Were already planning for another trip later this year.

reviews.author: Thomas B.
reviews.text: the mosquitos were overwhelming that park needs to be sprayed

reviews.author: Jenny J.
reviews.text: Lovely location to camp nestled under the pines along the river. Bathrooms are clean, no showers though. Lots of hiking along the river or spots to sit and enjoy the natural wonders.  Highly recommended but will be completely unplugged, theirs no cell reception and it's totally dry camping.

reviews.author: Debbie J.
reviews.text:
Absolutely beautiful location.     Many people riding bikes around the campground.    Bathrooms were very clean and well kept.   Our campsite was right on the Rogue River so we were able to listen to the roar of this year's bounty of water all day and all night.   Only a mile from Becky's restaurant and Union Creek Lodge and store so we got our fresh pie fix and could pick up anything we needed at the store.    Love it!  
Normally we also include a drive up to Crater Lake but this early in the season the north entrance was still closed due to snow.

reviews.author: Deanne H.
reviews.text: We loved our time at Farewell Bend CG! The location was perfect for visiting Crater Lake and fishing @ Diamond or Lemolo Lakes.  Our site was perfect for us, spacious and right on the river. Quiet on that side, no road noise at all. We would definitely stay here again and recommend this CG!

reviews.author: dennis s.
reviews.text: We have camped Ata farewell bend for over 20 years. The camp sites are wonderful

reviews.author: Chris P.
reviews.text: I stay in this campground each year. It is small but the sites are large with trees and nothing better than being close to the Rogue River. Also, not to far to drive to Be kid's for pie!

reviews.author: David S.
reviews.text: Nice campground

reviews.author: Rohn R.
reviews.text: Will post comments privately to Management.  This was a jewel of a campground in decades past.  Still quite nice but could use some love...

reviews.author: Suzette W.
reviews.text: Always a wonderful campground.

reviews.author: Mark F.
reviews.text: Campground was amazing! Camphost not so much. Not very friendly and a bit rude. Bathrooms were not maintained the entire time we were there Friday-Sunday! No toilet paper in either bathrooms and the womens bathrooms had a clogged toilet and was never fixed.

reviews.author: Dee Dee M.
reviews.text: Beautiful campground on the Rogue River just outside of Crater National Park.  Good for trout fishing. Small wonderful cafe and ice cream shop close by.

reviews.author: MICHAEL M.
reviews.text: We loved the large campsites, we were right on the river and it was so beautiful.

reviews.author: Dan F.
reviews.text: Site 42 was wonderful next to the Rogue River. Site was spacious and level. Bugs were minimal (end of July) and the bathrooms were all flush-type. A couple of womens' were clogged though. Drove up to camp host's trailer to check-in. I spoke to the host through a screen door and never saw her, which was a bit odd. Gave us some instructions and we headed to our site. Great campground and highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jennifer B.
reviews.text: We always enjoy camping here - the campsites are large and many are near the river.  People are respectful of the camp quiet rules.  We had an excellent time hiking at Crater Lake and chilling by the Rogue River.

reviews.author: Manan S.
reviews.text: The only minus that there are no showers otherwise exceptional campground!

reviews.author: Jonathan G.
reviews.text:
While the bathroom nearest us was “closed for maintenance” and the next closest one was rather basic, the campsite itself was very large, water was available nearby, and the river was just out the back. The river was the highlight with lots of little rapids/falls for the family to explore - it was one of our favorite things on our multi-state trip!
Definitely would recommend and will return!

reviews.author: Mackenzie K.
reviews.text:
This campground is beautiful! The campsites are far apart from each other so you really feel you have your privacy. The hiking trail offers beautiful views of the river; it was hot enough to swim in the river after soaking in the sun! There is also a camp store (near Union Creek Campground) walking distance from Farewell Bend, accessible via the hiking trail. We got hot coffees and a few items we forgot to bring. 

Our one not so great experience was a strange occurrence with the campground host. She approached our campsite after we arrived. She claimed we needed to pay for the cars we parked at our campsite. I casually explained that we paid for parking when we booked our campsite and offered to show her our reservation on my phone. She became very cross with me and claimed "the website didn't work" and then said she "was trying to be a welcoming camp host." She said both of these things with sarcasm. The situation quickly escalated and she said several contrasting things. Members of my party realized she was rather intoxicated; I feel foolish for not realizing this earlier. Before she left she disclosed she "had been drinking" and didn't "want things to get ugly." She left  our site claiming she would come by the next day to collect cash for the cars. She DID NOT come by the following day, which made me believe she was trying to scam us for $5-10. An overall weird experience, but I do not think she had the best intentions. An overall great stay, but beware of the host!

reviews.author: Karen H.
reviews.text: We have been coming to this campground for over 50 years and it's our favorite. This visit was the most disappointing. The campground host dropped the ball on cleanup as the bathrooms were never cleaned and the women's was out of toilet paper.

reviews.author: joanna b.
reviews.text: The campground was beautiful and quiet! We loved the nature playground and walking to the gorge.

reviews.author: Rudy H.
reviews.text:
We love this campground, but the bathrooms were not cleaned the whole time we were there.  We arrived on a Sunday and there was dried excrement on the toilet seat, toilet paper on the floor and the wastebasket was half full.  On Thursday when we left, everything was the same except the wastebasket was now overflowing.  We have stayed at Farewell Bend many times and it has never been like this.  What has changed?  Very disappointed in the maintenance, but still love the campground.
It is in walking distance of the Rogue Gorge and the sites are beautiful along the Rogue River.

reviews.author: David T.
reviews.text: Great place, beautiful area, and great camping. Hardly anyone there due to the conflict with the care giver companies. The forest service ladies who gave me info were great.

reviews.author: Steve M.
reviews.text: Great spot would be better if they had a dump station

reviews.author: David F.
reviews.text: We had a delightful site right on the Rogue River.

reviews.author: HARLEY G.
reviews.text: Had a good time at the site. Not too far from the National park which is good

reviews.author: SALLY C.
reviews.text: Such a beautiful location near the Gorge.  Great easy hiking and campsites are a generous size. Couldn't have been a better experience!

reviews.author: Barbara H.
reviews.text: Loved this campground,  spent 4 nights there,  very convenient  to go see crater later and natural  tunnel.  We camped in site #4 with a 36 ft motorhome, river was right behind us. Very Nice large, level  site. Plenty  of room between  sites. A little  but of road noise  but the river drowned out most of it.

reviews.author: Tim R.
reviews.text: N/A

reviews.author: Mark K.
reviews.text: Beautiful setting.

reviews.author: Brian W.
reviews.text: Beautiful site super close to get to crater lake and a well kept campground. Close to union gap camp store and gas in crater lake or Diamond lake. Very gracious host this season. Will stay here again

reviews.author: Bryan  S.
reviews.text: Our family of 4 boys ages 10 to 4, loved this place. The camp host was extremely  kind. We will return.

reviews.author: Dennis L.
reviews.text:
Absolutley love this place.
Bob and his wife (Hosts) were very nice to talk with.
This was our first RV experience to the area and only draw back was no dump station.

reviews.author: Nami C.
reviews.text: The camp site manager, Wilke was very resourceful and kind.  He takes interest in people who are staying and checked the camp sites on a regular basis for safety.  His help was greatly appreciated.  The camp site and bathroom were clean and quiet.

reviews.author: Steven S.
reviews.text: Great place to stop and stay at if you want to camp close-ish to crater lake! Lots of fishing and hiking all over the place!

reviews.author: Ruthann D.
reviews.text:
We have camped at Farewell Bend several times over the years, it is one of our favorite places!!!
Must see Crater Lake.

reviews.author: Tammra T.
reviews.text: Such a beautiful spot on the river! Sites are large and somewhat private. Camp hosts kept the campground nice and bathrooms were very clean.

reviews.author: Vikas A.
reviews.text: Na

reviews.author: Paulette E.
reviews.text: Beautiful campground with adequate services, but with one major negative.  Booked 1 campsite several months early for August visit on recreation.gov, claiming 3 people and 2 vehicles and paid the calculated price on-line.   After arriving at the campsite, I was "held up" by the camp host demanding another $12.50 per night for the second vehicle.  When I showed my recreation.gov receipt showing 2 vehicle claimed, I got this story that there was some USDA Forest Service requirement to pay an additional daily fee for second vehicle that doesn't flow through when making reservations on-line.  If this is actually true, why wasn't this calculated when I paid on line, or next best thing why wasn't there a note on-line explaining  a fee will be required on arrival when making the reservation for this campsite.  If the "bate and switch" fee is legitimate, fix you on-line reservation process to display the correct fee!   Thanks for the opportunity to comment.

reviews.author: bruce a.
reviews.text: Clean, well kept, close to a stream

reviews.author: Stephanie B.
reviews.text: We stayed here for 4 days and it was awesome! Great campsite, #32, right by the river, and plenty of privacy. The hosts are amazing as well. They had raked our campsite prior to our arrival, and were more than accommodating with our questions. We drove up to Crater Lake one day, hiked from camp to Rogue River Gorge, Natural Bridges and Upper Rogue River Trail. The gorge is a can't miss, and is less than half a mile from the camp. No campfires were a bummer, but still one of the nicest campsites we have had in a long time. HIGHLY recommend this campground!

reviews.author: Anne-Marie D.
reviews.text: Farewell Bend  is one of our favorite places to camp! The Camp Host's Bob and his wife were pleasant and respectful and kept that grounds nice and clean.

reviews.author: Jeanne B.
reviews.text: Farewell Bend campground is a beautiful scenic location right on the Rouge River. It is well maintained and clean. A peaceful experience even when most of the sites are full. Hiking trails are well marked and beautiful. The camp hosts were very helpful. Our favorite campground for a place to go to just unwind for a few days.

reviews.author: Yajing X.
reviews.text: Beautiful and spacious campground.

reviews.author: Sara D.
reviews.text: The part of the river behind camp, was low due to drought conditions. It made it awesome for the kids to climb around and play in swimming holes that are not normally accessible. Under normal conditions I would not choose sites along the river. The bathrooms were very clean, and the hosts were very nice

reviews.author: Howard S.
reviews.text: Had the grandkids with us 5 and 7. They were very disappointed that the tire swing was gone. Otherwise a 5 star experience. Nice clean campsite and restrooms. Always like the artistic raking around table.

reviews.author: David D.
reviews.text: Very beautiful setting.  Would be better with hookups.  Also, Jackson County will not allow dumping of grey and black water at Stewart Park making disposal more difficult.

reviews.author: Cathy J.
reviews.text: Farewell Bend is one of the most beautiful campgrounds we have visited. The camp hosts keep the park sparkling clean. Fishing was awesome with several nice spots to fish and hang out. We will be back soon!

reviews.author: Mary L.
reviews.text: It's our favorite place to camp.  It was beautiful weather, fishing was good and we liked our spot.

reviews.author: Daniel F.
reviews.text: always a nice place to stay

reviews.author: Michael L.
reviews.text: Farewell Bend Campground is conveniently located to the southwest of Crater Lake NP and nestled next to another gem - Rogue Creek Falls. Just a short hike out of camp and it's a nice site to see.  The campground is noticeably well-maintained by the camp hosts when I visited in July 2021!  Thank you!

reviews.author: Jennifer  P.
reviews.text: Didn’t want to take our chances with FF sites at Crater Lake so we booked here instead. We are so happy that we did because we absolutely loved the spacious sites, creek running through, quiet conditions, etc.

reviews.author: Douglas N.
reviews.text: The location was beautiful and the camp hosts were superb.  The campground was well kept.  loved it.

reviews.author: Jacob  S.
reviews.text: Beautiful campgrounds with all the amenities you'll need. The restrooms were clean. The play area for the kids is fantastic, and the location is great just by the Rogue river. The host was very helpful with a couple of questions.

reviews.author: John B.
reviews.text: Always have loved Farewell Bend. The river is beautiful and good fishing. Thanks for a great weekend!

reviews.author: Sara K.
reviews.text: It was just a quick drive to Crater Lake which made it easy to make it there for a sunrise hike. The campsite was right on the river and people definitely go swimming. Clean bathrooms and a quiet campground. Definitely would love to go again and for longer next time!

reviews.author: Dail d.
reviews.text: Too hot so I did NOT show up.  I should be billed for only the first night and refunded the balance.

reviews.author: Joe C.
reviews.text: Love being able to kayak or walk to the ocean.  Path by the Lagoon around the campsite was nice way to start the day.

reviews.author: Lucas T.
reviews.text: Beautiful campground. Absolutely stunning and loved being right on the Rogue river. Easy access to get up to Crater Lake.

reviews.author: Lynnette S.
reviews.text: Great place to stay if you're visiting Crater Lake.

reviews.author: Steve J.
reviews.text: Camp host Bob was Amazing, friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Carl S.
reviews.text: Very nice campground for RVs. Rained a lot. Will return!

reviews.author: Ragni M.
reviews.text: I stayed in Campsite 52. It was close to the toilet and quite spacious. Wood was readily available at the host site. Mostly rained half the time, but it was excellent spot to use, very close to Crater Lake.

reviews.author: Stephen W.
reviews.text: Campground hosts were wonderful!  Clean campground and felt safe.

reviews.author: Deborah S.
reviews.text: This is one of my favorite parks.  Just far enough away from home yet still close enough for a quick trip!  We stayed in site 47 this time, this will be my go to site if we go alone.  It rained 2 out of the 4 days we were there and this was a first trip with a 10 month old puppy.  He did great despite the rain.  Beautiful campground and they happened to be stocking the Rogue River while we were there.  Great fishing!  Host very friendly and our site was clean upon arrive.  Cant wait for our next camp trip!

reviews.author: Sheri E.
reviews.text: Pretty river location.  Nice hiking trails.  Good proximity to Crater Lake.

reviews.author: Connie  W.
reviews.text: Beautiful campground along the Rogue.  Very well maintained.

reviews.author: Anne P.
reviews.text: The camp hosts kept this campground spotless - clean sites and squeaky clean restrooms. Beautiful spot next to the Rogue River and an easy hike to the Canyon of the Rogue.

reviews.author: Kevin P.
reviews.text: One of our favorite places to dry camp. Camp hosts were very nice and kept the campgrounds impeccably clean. Great place for a jumping off point to Crater lake and all of the upper Rogue sights and hiking. My only complaint would be we have reserved several spots that were actually a shared camp, with two camps basically side by side. This should be made more apparent on the web site.

reviews.author: James O.
reviews.text: All great except for stool backups

reviews.author: Lea M.
reviews.text: The camp hosts this year are much better then last year. This is One of our favorite places to stay right on the river… So peaceful up there! Go up the road and get a Beckies Burger.. So delicious!!

reviews.author: Madeline M.
reviews.text:
Beautiful setting right on creek, clean bathroom, easy hike to view Rogue River Gorge. Sites are spacious. 

Friendly camp hosts.

reviews.author: Lonnie F.
reviews.text: In our 5 days at Farewell Bend,  we went to Crater Lake, Mill Creek Falls, National Creek Falls, Diamond Lake and Lemolo Lake. We arrived on Monday and it was 78 degrees and I’m Wednesday and Thursday it was snowing, but that didn’t slow us down much. We try to get there every year, but the last 3 years our reservations for middle of September, have been canceled or we did due to fires. This year we went in May, we love the place and the hosts are always very nice.

reviews.author: dennis s.
reviews.text: We were disappointed that they hadn't stocked trout yet at the campground.  Also it looks like they recently cut down trees leaving the cuttings and logs lay everywhere.  Do they plan on cleaning all of this up??  Hope so, we've been enjoying Farewell Bend for over 20 years and it's our favorite place!

reviews.author: Emilee Z.
reviews.text: Lovely site, amazing facilities, and a gorgeous river near the campground!! It was very cold, but again- so lovely.

reviews.author: Howard S.
reviews.text: We always look forward to camping at Farewell Bend. Beautiful big sites. Camp hosts have always been great. Lots to do in immediate vicinity.

reviews.author: George F.
reviews.text: Nice place

reviews.author: John J.
reviews.text: Reservation made the day before. On arrival in the area the wild fire smoke was so thick you could hardly breathe, and the police told me the roads were closed because of the fires, so there was no access to the campground! The reservation service made no mention of any of this. I paid for 2 nights and got NOTHING!

reviews.author: Pramod S.
reviews.text: Apart from the noise from the highway, the rest of it was pretty pleasurable. FYI: there are uninvited guests (read scorpions) in the campsite

reviews.author: Jane M.
reviews.text: This spacious campground is located on a beautiful bend of the upper Rogue River, with a large island to explore. The campground is just upstream of the Rogue River Gorge. There is an ice cream shop, a pie shop, and general store  nearby.

reviews.author: Hamed d.
reviews.text: Great campground.

reviews.author: Matthias L.
reviews.text: Lovely site next to the river and walking distance to the waterfall.

reviews.author: Whitney J.
reviews.text: Friendly neighbors, friendly camp host, and a great atmosphere.

reviews.author: Renee L.
reviews.text: Farewell Bend is nestled in old growth forest and is very close to the western entrance to Crater Lake. It is situated on a stream that provides a lovely background music of flowing water. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Whitney J.
reviews.text: Love the spots on the river!

reviews.author: Tim G.
reviews.text: Lovely campground right on the river.  Delightful to fall asleep to the sounds of rushing water.  Despite being next to the water, bugs were not particularly problematic.  Bathrooms but no showers, plenty of water spigots throughout.  Campground host is super helpful.  One drawback is campsites are not particularly private - a number of them are rented as single sites but are set up like group sites and share a common area with another site; even sites with trees between them are barely separated and the foliage is thin.  Campground is just down the road from Union Creek Resort where theres a general store, diner, ice cream and BBQ.  20 minutes to Crater Lake National Park which is an easy and spectacular half day visit (or full day if you are an ambitious hiker).

reviews.author: john c.
reviews.text: Beautiful clean campground

reviews.author: Myra A.
reviews.text: Campgrounds were clean. Restrooms were clean. Anti-bacterial was available. Toilets, Sinks and Counters were cleaned daily.  Water spigots were clean as well.  Most campers followed the rules. Quiet time was observed. No problems at all.

reviews.author: T.Marianne L.
reviews.text:
This Campsite was awesome! We enjoyed the smoothing sound of the river just below our camp!
The site is  a bit tight to get into but, was able to jackknife slightly with our 26 ft trailer to get into the site. We will definitely stay here again soon!

reviews.author: Jerome P.
reviews.text: My campsite was on top of the site to my left, only 9 feet between driveways!  Zero privacy!!!  The family that arrived after me were so upset they moved to another site.  Not all sites were like this but there were a number of them in the campground.  Other than that, a nice campground.

reviews.author: JAMES B.
reviews.text: Awesome Campground....Be advised no Dump Station there.

reviews.author: Marisa G.
reviews.text: Helpful hosts.  Lovely site.

reviews.author: Nancy P.
reviews.text: 2020 camp hosts leave much to be desired.  We were camped directly across from the oldest bathroom, and I never saw the camp hosts go in there to clean even one time over the 3 days we stayed here.  They pulled up to the bathroom in their golf cart, sat there for 20 minutes, never left the cart and then drove on.  We were in a trailer and never used the public bathroom, but I would seriously think twice about camping here if I was in a tent because the bathrooms are not being cleaned during the pandemic.  There was also a lot of trash in our campsite left from the previous campers.  I spent 3 days picking up little pieces of trash.

reviews.author: Carol K.
reviews.text: Large sites, shaded and sunny.

reviews.author: Kathleen B.
reviews.text: We have always loved camping at Farwell Bend.  The sound of the Rogue River at night puts us right to sleep.  It is the perfect location for exploring the various sites nearby (ie: Crater Lake, the Gorge and Natural Bridge).

reviews.author: matt b.
reviews.text: Good trees and river

reviews.author: Mary L.
reviews.text: We always enjoy camping there.  It's a quiet campground and we enjoy the fishing.  It's our favorite place to camp.

reviews.author: Libby W.
reviews.text:
We have called at Farewell Bend every summer season. The bathrooms were will keep up this summer but I was disappointed in the roads, and pads for RV's. They had not been cleaned and we're COVERED in a deep layer of pine needles. I've never seen it that bad. I swept our site clean except under the RV. 
PEOPLE This summer had no respect for camp sites, trudging through our site to get to the river when there was a path a little ways down. Next time, I want to take yellow caution tape and encircle my camp space, telling others to go around. 
Also, this time, several dogs were NOT ON leashes, one running and trying to attack our small dog. My husband yelled and I smacked the dog with my cane! THEN the owner came to retrieve the dog. The camp hosts said hello when we first pulled in but didn't enforce rules or do much maintenance as far as we could see except the bathrooms- and they were clean. 
We'll still go again, probably take a battery powered blower with us!

reviews.author: Fred M.
reviews.text: Absolutely love this campground, will go back.  Nicely spread out and quiet.  Camp hosts were very friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Richard S.
reviews.text: even though it is somewhat a no frills campground as far as trailer hookups it is a beautiful place to visit.  the Rogue river is right there and has interesting things to see as well as some decent trout fishing.  Most sites have pretty level driveways for setting up trailers and are large enough to set up a tent or 2.

reviews.author: Mike S.
reviews.text: The campgrounds were super clean. Excellent area for children. We took our grandchildren fishing and caught several fish.

reviews.author: GARY W.
reviews.text: One of our favorite places to camp in Oregon.

reviews.author: Chris W.
reviews.text:
We had a reservation September 4-6, 2019.  When we arrived, the campground had NO WATER.  We did not receive any notice by Rec.gov that the water system was not working.  Very inconvenient!  
Also, not impressed with the campground in general.  Most of all, the campground is right adjacent to a fairly busy highway, which means a lot of highway noise.
Fortunately, we found Union Creek Campground nearby, and found a nice campsite.  Unfortunately, the cost of our campsite fees was then double, having abandoned Farewell Bend.
There needs to be some kind of system of notifying, by email or text, that a campground one has booked, has a problem with providing the advertised services.

reviews.author: Steve D.
reviews.text: It met our needs. We stayed here to get an early start on the "Ride the Rim" at Crater Lake. It was quiet and the spots were good sized. The campground is clean and well maintained.

reviews.author: Murray O.
reviews.text: The hosts were the best, hope to see them again this year. Farewell bend is close to home quiet and the sites are well maintained.

reviews.author: Fred M.
reviews.text: very nice campground.  Will visit again.

reviews.author: Kaylen  C.
reviews.text: Right next to a beautiful river, secluded camping areas, the only downside is if you are camping for carter lake it’s a bit of a drive.

reviews.author: john c.
reviews.text: Beautiful and clean spot.  Great camp hosts.

reviews.author: Trudi T.
reviews.text: Overall great campground! Host was incredibly nice and helpful. Next to the beautiful Rogue River and an easy drive to Crater Lake. If you are considering camping near Crater Lake, this is the campground to go to. Cheap, clean, peaceful, and beautiful.

reviews.author: Holly C.
reviews.text: Love the area.  Great camp hosts.

reviews.author: Kimberly S.
reviews.text: Beautiful campground, the only one really that we will pay to stay at. The camp hosts are wonderful people as well.  It is close to Creator Lake and not very far from Diamond Lake, great day trips. Also located on the Rogue River Gorge where Becky's is and the Natural Bridge, absolutely beautiful. Best part is just relaxing near the the river.  Can't wait to go again.  :)

reviews.author: Heidi H.
reviews.text: Farewell Bend USED to be our family's favorite campsite and we visited a few times annually. Last Summer on Labor Day weekend, we were shocked to find ALL the bathrooms closed and NO access to water. We were informed by the camphosts that Portable Potties had been ordered and would be arriving in an hour. They didn't arrive until late that afternoon. This is unacceptable when tent-camping, especially for women and children. We were forced to find secluded areas within the campground which is not easy nor hygienic. I asked the camphost what had happened, and was told the water pump was very old and should have been replaced years ago, and this situation had happened MANY times! This is clearly an ongoing issue and it doesn't make sense that it hasn't been addressed. As one of the more expensive campgrounds, I'm outraged that the private corporation who manages the site would pinch profits over maintaining a beautiful, pristine spot for future generations. It really saddens me because we cannot trust that the campground will be an enjoyable experience. We won't be coming back until the pumps are fixed.

reviews.author: Nicolas C.
reviews.text: Easy to find, clean and quiet, close to the river and sites have plenty of room.

reviews.author: John B.
reviews.text:
A very beautiful and relaxing campground (except for the campers running a generator all day while they were away). We had a spot right on the river that was very private.
Be aware that there is another campground in eastern Oregon with the same name. I had to check twice when Google maps was sending me to the eastern part of the state.

reviews.author: Rudy H.
reviews.text: There are so many things to see and do in this area, the Rogue Gorge is beautiful and the trail where the river goes underground.  Can't miss Becky's Pies!!  The river through the campground is wild and gorgeous and the fishing is great for our grandkids.  Not far from Crater Lake or Diamond Lake!

reviews.author: Katherine Gay G.
reviews.text: The camp hosts are the absolute best.  The campground and bathrooms are spotless.  They even rake each site when campers leave.  The sites are large, and you can get a "double" site if you want to be close to your camping buddies.  We were in two different sites, one was on the river and had a perfect place to sit and enjoy a book or a favorite beverage.  The other spot backed up to lots of trees and space.  The river is NOT SAFE for kayaking, canoeing, dogs or humans for swimming or wading.  At the end of the park the water becomes narrow and VERY fast and dangerous.  We hiked to Natural Bridge from the campground, an easy mostly flat hike.  It's also an easy drive to Crater Lake for a day trip.  There is no cell/internet service but you can take the short drive to Union Creek to check email and check in with friends/relatives if need be.  The little store nearby has ice and some basic necessities.  If you want some of the best pie around, be sure to visit Shari's Cafe and Pies.  There is also an ice cream shop, but we did not visit there.  There is a lot of shade for every spot that we could see throughout the campground.  Plenty of pavement to get your daily walk in, or bike riding for the kids.

reviews.author: Michael S.
reviews.text: We had an amazing time at the farewell bend campground.  Our Grandsons spent the majority of time fishing or bike riding.  The weather was warm and clear and we had wonderful neighbors on each side.  The only downfall was that it was not a long enough stay, wish we could have spent more time there.  We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: jan lee m.
reviews.text: Hosts were excellent!
